diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions without sufficient state change. They contain 1,485 repeated operations versus 224 in base/good runs (6.63×; net excess +1,261), dominated by repeated clicks (+639), no-ops (+356), and scrolls (+277).
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged state before retrying forces strategy changes, reducing loops and wasted operations. The cost is state comparison plus occasional premature switching when progress is subtle.
policy_text: Before repeating an action, compare the current observable state with the state before the previous attempt. If no task-relevant change occurred, do not repeat the same action unchanged; revise the target, parameters, or strategy. Permit one retry only when a transient failure is explicitly indicated.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated operations have net candidate-minus-base excess +1,261; associated excess includes click +639, noop +356, and scroll +277.
Base/good side contains 224 repeated operations (shown as -224 by the differential profile), making candidate/bad 6.63× higher.
